sources.title: Repository overview
sources.note: Public master snapshot reviewed; no local checkout or implementation test. Resolve HEAD again before work.

sources.title: Existing work map
sources.note: Existing P0–P3 task identifiers and dependencies.

sources.title: Existing architecture
sources.note: APP-01 selects the engine; reuse and bounded contracts are existing decisions.

sources.title: APP-01 packet
sources.note: Existing-app comparison before a new client.

sources.title: TRANSIT-01 packet
sources.note: Existing transit assessment is P3 and depends on DATA-01.

sources.title: Existing provider policy
sources.note: Licenses, offline rights, provenance, costs and safe pack lifecycle.

sources.title: Agent entry point
sources.note: Scope, human authorization, evidence kinds and canonical JSON.

sources.title: Agent run contract
sources.note: One accepted task per PR; reviewer, cap and stop conditions.

sources.title: Canonical task registry
sources.note: Current task metadata; rebase proposed additions rather than replacing this file.

sources.title: Existing source registry
sources.note: Existing inspirations and provider-policy findings; retain these records.

sources.title: Board renderer
sources.note: Generates contribution views from canonical data; current phase loop is P0–P3.

sources.title: Repository validator
sources.note: Inspect constraints before extending data schemas or evidence.

sources.title: CoMaps official source mirror
sources.note: Whole-app/offline baseline; primary development is on Codeberg. Apache-2.0 at project level, with NOTICE/data/component terms to inspect.

sources.title: CoMaps Linux distribution listing
sources.note: Listing explicitly warns that Linux does not yet match mobile feature parity; not an Omarchy qualification result.

sources.title: CoMaps contribution guide
sources.note: Links upstream AI-usage policy; obtain and respect the current policy before contributions.

sources.title: CoMaps AI-usage policy target
sources.note: Linked by upstream contribution guide, but policy body was inaccessible in this research session. Do not infer permission.

sources.title: GNOME Maps
sources.note: Desktop planning baseline based on OpenStreetMap.

sources.title: GNOME developer announcement of Transitous integration
sources.note: Historical primary announcement from 2024; demonstrates prior integration, not current region coverage. Verify installed version.

sources.title: Organic Maps
sources.note: Alternative whole-app/offline navigation reference; do not build a second fork by default.

sources.title: MapLibre GL JS
sources.note: Browser vector-map renderer; not search, routing or navigation.

sources.title: MapLibre Native
sources.note: Native rendering family; platform integration must be qualified.

sources.title: MapLibre Native Qt
sources.note: Qt bindings and Qt Location plugin; candidate for a justified native surface.

sources.title: MOTIS
sources.note: Multimodal routing, geocoding and tiles; REST/OpenAPI. Human-facing upstream communication must be human-written.

sources.title: MOTIS configuration and realtime inputs
sources.note: OSM plus timetable inputs, realtime and GBFS configuration; pin the release before implementing.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner
sources.note: OTP2 server uses GTFS/OSM and realtime updates, exposes GraphQL; JVM deployment and LGPL-3.0 license need release-specific review.

sources.title: Valhalla
sources.note: MIT routing engine with tiled graph architecture; test route profiles, instructions and device resource requirements.

sources.title: Photon
sources.note: Apache-2.0 geocoder with typeahead, multilingual search and reverse geocoding; data and import dependencies remain separate.

sources.title: Pelias data-source architecture
sources.note: Alternative multi-source geocoder; do not assume every new dataset has a maintained importer.

sources.title: Pelias runtime requirements
sources.note: Search backend/version requirements matter; review bundled dependency licenses and operational costs.

sources.title: Protomaps basemaps
sources.note: Basemap generation plus matching cartographic styles; preserve tile-schema/style compatibility.

sources.title: Planetiler
sources.note: Build tool for vector tiles, including PMTiles output; build infrastructure is not a phone runtime.

sources.title: PMTiles concepts
sources.note: Tile archive accessed with byte ranges; read-only format, not a search index or route graph.

sources.title: PMTiles MapLibre GL integration
sources.note: Documented GL JS protocol integration; do not assume identical Native/Qt support.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap copyright and license
sources.note: OSM data is ODbL, independent of application code licensing.

sources.title: OSMF tile-server policy
sources.note: Standard public tile service is not a bulk/offline-download backend.

sources.title: Public Nominatim policy
sources.note: Public endpoint: application-wide maximum 1 request/second and no client autocomplete; self-hosted software is a different case.

sources.title: Geofabrik British Columbia extract
sources.note: OSM PBF input and update files. Source version and acquired digest must be pinned.

sources.title: BC Transit open-data catalog
sources.note: Kelowna links static GTFS plus alerts, trip updates and vehicle positions. Binary bodies were not decoded in this session.

sources.title: BC Transit data terms
sources.note: Limited, revocable license with attribution and other conditions; not equivalent to unrestricted public-domain data.

sources.title: GTFS Schedule specification
sources.note: Canonical timetable specification; service dates, times and supported optional features must be respected.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime specification
sources.note: Trip updates, vehicle positions and service alerts have distinct semantics.

sources.title: MobilityData GTFS validator
sources.note: Apache-2.0 static-feed validator; validation alone is not a successful itinerary or realtime test.

sources.title: Mobility Database
sources.note: Discovery catalog for GTFS, GTFS-RT and GBFS; individual feed terms still apply.

sources.title: Transitous API policy
sources.note: Optional community-operated MOTIS service with eligibility, identification, attribution and usage limits; not a mandatory default.

sources.title: General Bikeshare Feed Specification
sources.note: Shared-mobility availability standard; discovery is distinct from booking/payment.

sources.title: Overture Places guide
sources.note: Business/place data with source-dependent provenance and licensing; not a review corpus.

sources.title: Overture attribution and licensing
sources.note: Theme and source-specific licenses; do not label all Overture data CC0 or one blanket license.

sources.title: AllThePlaces
sources.note: Existing location-data extraction project; assess published data and provenance before launching new crawlers.

sources.title: Panoramax integration
sources.note: Open street imagery API using OGC/STAC; viewer and images have separate terms.

sources.title: Panoramax self-hosting
sources.note: Federated/self-hostable imagery infrastructure; does not provide uniform worldwide photographic coverage.

sources.title: Panoramax federation requirements
sources.note: Imagery/metadata licensing and anonymization requirements; check the actual instance and image.

sources.title: DriveBC Open511 API
sources.note: Documented road events under OGL-BC and API terms. Event overlays are not live network-wide speed data.

sources.title: GeoClue Location interface
sources.note: Timestamp can be receipt time, cached or non-monotonic; do not invent measurement provenance.

sources.title: GeoClue Client interface
sources.note: Application identity, permissions, provider state and updates need integration.

sources.title: Android LocationManager
sources.note: Platform location API candidate; separately review target SDK, permissions and background lifecycle.

sources.title: StreetComplete
sources.note: Existing OSM contribution workflow to learn from or hand off to; no automated edits authorized.

sources.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2
sources.note: Satellite imagery candidate for later layers; not equivalent to street-level or high-resolution aerial coverage.

sources.title: Omamesh
sources.note: MeshCore messaging/advertised-contact map integration. Current README names Esri/OSM online basemaps and an offline coordinate grid; reuse transport/normalization separately from map-provider choices.

sources.title: Omastorm
sources.note: Rust/Quickshell weather-radar integration; observation timestamps, stale states and provider coverage. Do not infer Canada-wide radar, forecasts, warnings or GNSS from the app.
